mechanism: Both agents are carbonic anhydrase inhibitors or act similarly; combined use increases risk of hypokalemia, metabolic acidosis, and electrolyte abnormalities, with additive effects on aqueous humor production and systemic effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, bicarbonate) regularly; assess for signs of hypokalemia and metabolic acidosis; consider alternative therapy or use lowest effective doses with frequent monitoring.
